title: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure not accepted by the network

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure not accepted
entities.description: Procedure initiated when the network does not accept a UE's request for bearer resource modification.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by the network to reject a UE's bearer resource modification request.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for rejection of the bearer resource modification request.

entities.name: Network rejection condition
entities.description: Condition where the network decides not to accept the UE's bearer resource modification request.

relations.description: The procedure includes the network sending a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message.
The BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message contains the EMM cause IE indicating the rejection reason.
The network rejection condition triggers the UE requested bearer resource modification procedure not accepted.
